Maya found the whistle behind the birthday candles, where the drawer kept things nobody had asked for in years.

It was tin, and dented, and cold even though the kitchen was warm. She blew one note into it and the dog put his head under the table.

"Did you hear that?" she asked.

"Hear what?" said her brother, and went back to his cereal.

***

So she carried it to Grandmother's room, where the window was open and the radio was off, and she played the note again.

Grandmother listened all the way to the end. "That one," she said, "is the note for the sea."
